idea: Event-driven rigidity surgery that projects smooth-max gradients onto the nullspace of the near-contact rigidity matrix to slide along floppy modes and jam new contacts.
direction: Perform rigidity-building surgery aimed explicitly at creating contacts: build the rigidity matrix for all pairs with slack $<5\times10^{-6}$ in per-point tangent coordinates, compute its nullspace or smallest singular directions by SVD, and solve small LPs/QPs that decrease the current maximum while moving preferentially along floppy modes until a new pair enters the active set. Iterate this event-driven procedure, each time adding the newly contacted pairs and recomputing the rigidity rank, while specifically relocating points of lowest near-contact degree along descent directions rather than teleporting them randomly. The target structural signature is a spanning, approximately isostatic contact graph with average near-contact degree approaching $2\cdot975/82\approx23.8$ and no zero-degree points at a $10^{-5}$ tolerance.

idea: Leave the single-contact plateau by basin-hopping with annealed LogSumExp Adam quenches from global kicks and worst-point hole reinsertion, finished by a capped trust-region LP squeeze.
Polish the incumbent with annealed LogSumExp minimax via L-BFGS then wide-threshold trust-region LP.
direction: First extract the easy descent left in the incumbent by polishing it correctly: starting from `best.npy`, minimise a smooth minimax surrogate such as $p^{-1}\log\sum_{i<j}\exp(p\langle x_i,x_j\rangle)$ with analytic gradients using L-BFGS on normalised variables, annealing $p=100\to1000\to10000$, then finish with an active-set LP that includes all pairs with slack below $\max(5\times10^{-6},20\times\text{trust radius})$ rather than $10^{-9}$. Adapt the trust radius by true max-cosine improvement, impose a hard internal deadline near 150 seconds, check the clock every iteration, reserve the final 20 seconds for one capped HiGHS polish, and always return the best feasible array encountered; this tests whether the $10^{-6}$ plateau yields a substantially lower genuine local optimum without any basin hopping.

idea: Basin-hopping with far-hole reinsertion and large kicks followed by annealed LogSumExp Adam quenches and selective capped trust-region LP polish to leave the single-contact basin.
Far-basin hopping with annealed LogSumExp Adam quenches, hole re-insertion and large kicks, avoiding LP during search with one short final squeeze to leave the single-contact plateau.
Alternate wide-shell minimax LP with tail-sum LP under lexicographic acceptance to compress the dense near-contact shell.
direction: Perform collective tail-compression SQP/LP on the record instead of single-pair polishing: at each iteration form the wide active set of the top 1200–2000 pairs (or all pairs within $2\times10^{-3}$ of the max), solve a sparse HiGHS LP that minimises $t$ subject to linearised $\langle x_i,x_j\rangle\le t$ on that whole set, tangent constraints $\langle x_i,\delta_i\rangle=0$, and a small trust region ($10^{-4}$ to $10^{-3}$), then alternate with a second LP step minimising the linearised weighted sum of the top-500 cosines subject to no pair exceeding the current best. Accept a step only if the lexicographic pair (max cosine, mean of top-100 cosines, log-sum-exp of top-500) improves, otherwise halve the trust region; this directly squeezes the entire shell that blocks the isolated pair. Cap each LP at about 1s, stop all optimisation by 135s, and return the best configuration ever seen.

From-scratch diverse seeds with annealed hinge/power quenches, rigidity-based archive and Procrustes crossover, single LP polish.
direction: Search for a genuinely new jammed basin from scratch, ignoring best.npy/record.npy except as a fallback return value: generate diverse seeds by random sampling, greedy far-hole construction, and perturbed lattice-like point sets, then run many short (2–5s) quenches minimising an annealed hinge/power objective $\sum_{i<j}\max(0,\langle x_i,x_j\rangle-T)^p$ with $T$ stepped through 0.205, 0.200, 0.197, 0.194 and $p$ from 2 to 6, promoting only seeds whose $10^{-3}$-contact count and per-point contact distribution look rigid (e.g. hundreds of near-contacts and few zero-contact points) even if their max is initially slightly worse. Maintain a small diversity archive keyed by sorted Gram spectrum and sorted near-contact degrees, cross only archive members with different fingerprints by Procrustes alignment plus point exchange, and reserve only the final 20s for LP polishing the single most jammed candidate, all inside 140s.

idea: Symmetric orbit plus sparse combinatorial seeds optimized with softmax Adam, then released to full-point Adam and finished with brief wide active-set LP polish under a strict deadline.
direction: Explore symmetric/algebraic constructions that the unstructured record basin appears to lack: parametrise codes by a few generator unit vectors in $\mathbb{R}^{14}$ together with a finite group action such as signed coordinate permutations, cyclic coordinate shifts, or block sign flips, generate the resulting orbits, trim or pad deterministically to exactly 82 points, and optimise only the low-dimensional generators with Adam on a softmax-max objective so the outcome is highly contacted and symmetric by construction. In parallel, enumerate combinatorial seeds from sparse patterns with support sizes 2–4 and coordinates in $\{0,\pm1,\pm a\}$ (with $a$ optimised on a small grid), greedily select 82 low-correlation vectors, then gradually break the symmetry by releasing first the generators, then all individual points, finishing with a brief wide-active-set LP polish and a strict 135s return deadline.

idea: Repeated shell surgery deleting the contact pair plus high weighted-degree points and reinserting into far holes with annealed softmax Adam, judged lexicographically with fingerprint archive and sparse LP polish only on topology change.
direction: Do targeted subset surgery on the shell: compute weighted degrees using pairs within $10^{-3}$ of the max, repeatedly delete the two contact points plus 6, 12, or 20 of the highest-degree shell points (sometimes also a few zero-degree rattlers), freeze the remaining points, and jointly reinsert/reoptimise the deleted subset using far-hole candidates drawn from 50k–100k random sphere samples followed by annealed softmax Adam (temperature/alpha increasing from about 50 to 500, target cosine descending from 0.198 to 0.195). Judge trials by (max, top-100 mean, top-500 mean), not max alone, keep an archive of distinct contact-graph fingerprints at tolerance $10^{-3}$, and only after a subset move changes that fingerprint apply a short wide-active-set LP polish; run many short surgeries under a 135s deadline rather than a few long quenches.

idea: Escape the single-contact plateau with kicked basin-hopping quenched by annealed soft-max tangent momentum descent, finished by a small capped trust-region minimax LP.

idea: Build a discrete symmetric basin from low-weight signed patterns plus cyclic-shift orbits, greedy max-min select 82, tune orbit seeds low-dimensionally, then smooth-max Adam and LP polish versus incumbent.
direction: Search for a symmetry-constrained or discrete structured code instead of perturbing the incumbent: generate candidate vectors from signed coordinate patterns in $\mathbb{R}^{14}$, such as normalized permutations of $(\pm1,\pm1,0,\ldots)$, $(\pm1,\pm1,\pm1,0,\ldots)$, and related low-weight patterns, or generate orbits of a few seed vectors under cyclic coordinate shifts and sign changes so that balanced contacts occur by construction. Use fast vectorized greedy max-min selection from a pool capped near $20{,}000$ candidates to choose $82$ points, optimize any group-orbit seeds in their low-dimensional parameter space, and only then release all coordinates for a short smooth-max Adam and LP polish. Compare this structurally different basin against `best.npy` under a $120$s budget and return whichever has the smaller exact maximum.

idea: Kick-and-reinsert basin hopping from the record with annealed power-hinge Adam quenches and a single capped trust-region LP squeeze.
Epsilon-active equalization SQP that unions slack-epsilon and top-K pair sets with tightening epsilon schedule and inactive-shell penalty in the LP objective to grow a balanced contact network.
direction: Build an epsilon-active equalization SQP that starts from `best.npy`, defines active pairs by slack $<10^{-6}$ or the top $1000$ pairs, and progressively tightens epsilon through $10^{-6},3\times10^{-7},10^{-7},3\times10^{-8},10^{-8}$ while increasing the forced-active set $K=200,400,800$. At each stage solve a sparse HiGHS LP in tangent coordinates with linearized cosines for active pairs constrained to a common $t$, a penalty for inactive-pair violations, and a trust region adapted from $10^{-3}$ downward, accepting a step only if the exact maximum decreases or the number of pairs within $10^{-7}$ and the minimum contact degree increase without increasing the maximum. Track contacts at several thresholds, not just $10^{-9}$, stop all optimization by $120$s, and return the best exact configuration found.

idea: Build a discrete symmetric pool of low-weight signed patterns plus dense random vectors, greedy max-min select 82 points and optimize cyclic-shift orbit seeds in low dimensions, then release to full Adam/LP polish and keep the better of structured basin versus incumbent.

Build the tangent-space rigidity Jacobian of the top near-contact pairs and slide along its lowest SVD floppy directions with logarithmic steps plus exact retraction, then quench only the few most balanced candidates with short annealed LogSumExp Adam and one capped minimax LP.
direction: Compute the rigidity Jacobian of the top $500$--$1000$ near-contact pairs in an orthonormal tangent basis, giving an approximately $1000\times1066$ matrix, then use its SVD to identify the lowest $20$--$50$ floppy or near-null directions along which active cosines change only to second order. Search exact spherical configurations along random combinations of these directions over logarithmic step sizes from $10^{-4}$ to $3\times10^{-2}$, including a second-order retraction back to the sphere, and keep candidates whose maximum is no worse but whose contact distribution becomes more balanced or whose next-pair slack profile improves. Quench only the best few candidates with short annealed LogSumExp Adam followed by one capped LP polish, with a strict internal deadline and best-so-far retention.
